verdict.rationale: Official docs confirm native Android and iOS SDKs (plus JS/React Native) for building custom in-person payment integrations, with community hands-on confirmation of building a full POS on top of Stripe Terminal's API-level SDK integration, including Connect support. Missing for 10: independent third-party review of iOS/Android SDK quality specifically, and no direct GitHub repo evidence for the native mobile SDKs (only JS SDK repo cited).
